comments.body: Go to the VCS website, there’s a lot of information on how to learn, what to learn or how relevant some things are/aren’t. You can also ask your TA’s for advice in the “Übungsstunden” or write them an email, I’m sure they’ll be happy to help. There are also PVK’s (Prüfungsvorbereitungskurse) at the end of the spring semester which are courses that are quite good to prepare oneself for the upcoming exams from the “Basisjahr”. They cost little and I’ve found them quite helpful. If you’re not willing to pay you can also download old PVK-skripts that are uploaded to the VCS website or general skripts that or often quite refined and good to learn with. Hope that helps :).
comments.author: Proud_Process3548
